_needs_antigravity.$comment: GOVERNOR: paste the block below to ANTIGRAVITY. It has the real tree; this skeleton only covers files confirmed during the 2026-08-12 audit. Do NOT let it guess a zone - unknown files get 'UNZONED' and a WARN, which is the correct honest state.
_needs_antigravity.prompt: Read zones.json in the repo root. Then enumerate every file under src/, backend/src/, and cisem_core/ that is not already listed in the 'paths' object. For each, output one line: <relative/path> | <proposed zone Z0|Z1|Z2|Z3|ZX|UNKNOWN> | <the one import or usage that justifies it>. Rules: Z0 = cisem_core, gate, registries, operator-only surfaces. Z1 = identity, tenancy, entitlement, templates, shared UI primitives, shared data access. Z2 = catalog, proposals, briefs, branding, suppliers - the gifting vertical. Z3 = routes and thin page composition. ZX = generic project management with no backend counterpart. UNKNOWN = you cannot justify a zone from the file's actual imports. Do NOT guess: UNKNOWN is a correct answer and is preferred over a confident wrong one. Output the list only. Do not modify zones.json. Do not run any other command.
_needs_antigravity.then: CLAUDE reviews the proposals before any path is added. E14 is not built until this file is complete.
